name: Volixta Task Manager Lite
author: VOLIXTA TEAM

sections.description:
Volixta Task Manager Lite brings project and task management directly into your WordPress dashboard. Organize projects, manage tasks, plan deadlines, and track progress in one intuitive, self-hosted workspace.

From customer requests to actionable tasks. With the optional Volixta Support integration, turn support tickets into linked project tasks and manage customer requests alongside your everyday work.

Your workspace, your data. No external account or subscription is required. Your projects and tasks stay on your WordPress site.

Designed for freelancers, developers, and website owners, the Lite edition provides a personal workspace for one WordPress administrator, without multi-user collaboration.

Organize projects with Kanban boards

  • Create unlimited personal projects and tasks.
  • Start with To Do, In Progress and Done, then rename, reorder or add your own Kanban stages.
  • Drag tasks between stages to update their progress.
  • Switch between board, list and calendar views within a project.
  • Search tasks and filter work by status.
  • Duplicate projects or tasks and archive work you no longer need on your active boards.
  • Assign custom colors to projects for easier identification.

Keep all your tasks in one place

  • Give each task a title, description, priority, start date and due date.
  • Add labels and checklists to break larger tasks into smaller steps.
  • Review task activity and mark work as completed.
  • Use My Tasks to see work across your projects, including active, completed and overdue tasks.
  • Open a task to edit its details, checklist and attachments without losing your place.

Calendar, deadlines and reminders

  • See scheduled tasks in a monthly calendar.
  • Identify calendar tasks by their project’s color, with a project color legend.
  • Check upcoming and overdue tasks from the Task Manager dashboard.
  • Add an optional WordPress Dashboard widget that groups unfinished work into overdue, today, tomorrow, the next seven days, later and tasks without a due date.
  • Follow tasks directly from the WordPress Dashboard widget to their details.
  • Enable optional on-screen deadline reminders and email reminders.
  • Review scheduled, accepted and failed email attempts in Notifications, with manual sending or resending where available.

Email reminders are off by default. When enabled, they use WordPress wp_mail() and WP-Cron. Send times can vary depending on site traffic and your WordPress mail setup. A message accepted by WordPress is not necessarily delivered to the inbox.

Reports and exports

  • View totals for all tasks, completed tasks and open tasks.
  • Check overall completion and progress for each project.
  • Export task information in CSV or JSON format.

Exports do not include an automatic backup of encrypted attachment files. Keep your usual WordPress site backups.

Private, encrypted attachments

Add supported files to tasks, up to 10 MB per file or your site’s lower upload limit. Private attachments are encrypted using AES-256-GCM and downloaded through an authenticated WordPress endpoint. Project and task information is stored in dedicated tables in your own WordPress database.

Private attachments require OpenSSL support and a writable WordPress uploads directory. Do not change the WordPress authentication salts without planning for the encrypted files, as doing so can prevent their decryption.

Choose the interface that suits you

Choose between three interface modes:

  • Standard: a light, familiar interface.
  • Immersive: a dark workspace with clear navigation.
  • Focus: a minimal layout with fewer distractions.

A six-step setup wizard helps you choose an appearance, create your first project, adjust your workflow and set reminder preferences. You can skip the wizard or change your settings later.

Optional Volixta Support integration

Volixta Task Manager Lite includes an optional integration with Volixta Support, allowing you to turn customer support requests into manageable tasks.

When both plugins are installed and active, you can:

  • Search existing support tickets by ticket number or subject.
  • Create a task directly from a support ticket.
  • Automatically use the ticket subject as the task title.
  • Carry over the ticket priority to the new task.
  • Link the task to its original support ticket.
  • Choose a project for the task or use an existing project automatically.
  • Reopen previously linked tasks without creating duplicates.
  • Navigate between linked tickets and tasks.
  • Access Task Manager actions from the Volixta Support admin interface.

For example, when a customer submits a support ticket requesting a website correction, you can create a linked task in Volixta Task Manager Lite, organize it on your Kanban board and track its progress.

The original ticket remains in Volixta Support, while the related task is managed in Task Manager Lite. The integration creates a link between the two records; it does not automatically synchronize their statuses, comments or attachments.

This integration is available to the authorized WordPress administrator.

Volixta Support is optional. Volixta Task Manager Lite works independently without it.

Discover more plugins with Volixta Ecosystem

The Volixta Ecosystem page lets you discover and manage other Volixta WordPress plugins directly from the Task Manager interface.

From this page, you can:

  • Browse other Volixta plugins and their descriptions.
  • Check whether a listed plugin is active, installed or available.
  • Install supported plugins from the WordPress.org directory when you have the required permissions.
  • Activate plugins that are already installed.
  • Open active plugins or access their management pages.
  • Visit external product websites when direct installation is unavailable.

For supported plugins hosted on WordPress.org, click Install plugin to start the standard WordPress installation process. Once installed, return to the Ecosystem page and click Activate plugin if activation is required.

You can also install plugins manually from Plugins > Add New Plugin in WordPress.

Available Volixta plugins include:

  • Volixta Support – Manage customer support tickets and link support requests to Task Manager tasks.
  • Volixta Analytics Lite – Track website visitors and traffic directly from WordPress.
  • Volixta SSL & Security Headers – Manage SSL and HTTP security headers for WordPress.
  • Volixta Database Manager – Explore database tables, review options and clean up unnecessary data.
  • Volixta Booking – Appointment scheduling and booking management.

Volixta Booking is linked to its external website and is not installed automatically from the Ecosystem page.

All additional Volixta plugins are optional. You can use Volixta Task Manager Lite without installing any of them.

Who is this plugin for?

Volixta Task Manager Lite is useful if you want to manage your own WordPress website projects, development work, content plans, maintenance checklists or personal deadlines without switching to a separate task management service.

Please note: The Lite workspace belongs to one WordPress administrator. It does not provide multi-user collaboration, team roles or frontend task submission.

Security and Uninstall

Task Manager Lite uses private, owner-restricted WordPress endpoints and dedicated database tables. Private attachments are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and require authenticated downloads. The plugin does not need an external task management account to store its core project and task data.

Email reminders are optional and use your site’s WordPress mail system and WP-Cron. Data shared with an optional Volixta Support integration is subject to that plugin’s permissions.

Important: Deactivation keeps your project data. Uninstallation permanently deletes plugin-specific data, database tables, settings, notification history and encrypted attachments. Make a full backup before uninstalling. Preserve WordPress authentication salts to keep existing encrypted files readable.

  • Volixta Booking — Booking, services, staff, customers, payments and locations for WordPress.
  • Volixta Analytics Lite — Privacy-focused visitor and traffic insights.
  • Volixta SSL & Security Headers — SSL and essential HTTP security headers.
  • Volixta Database Manager — Browse tables, maintain options and clean up database records.
  • Volixta Support — Manage customer support tickets, conversations and requests directly from WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for “Volixta Task Manager Lite” when available in the directory, or choose Upload Plugin and select the ZIP file.
  2. Activate the plugin while signed in as the administrator who will own the personal workspace.
  3. Follow the six-step setup wizard, or skip it to use the default settings.
  4. Open Volixta Task Manager in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Create a project, add tasks and choose your deadlines, stages and checklists.
  6. Optionally enable email reminders in Settings and enable the WordPress Dashboard widget.
  7. To connect support tickets, install and activate Volixta Support, then open Integrations in Task Manager.
  8. To discover other Volixta plugins, open Volixta Ecosystem and use the available installation, activation or navigation actions.
sections.faq:
Does Volixta Task Manager Lite require Volixta Support?

No. Volixta Task Manager Lite works independently. Volixta Support is only required if you want to create tasks linked to support tickets.

How does the Volixta Support integration work?

Install and activate both plugins. You can then search for support tickets and create linked tasks from the Task Manager integration interface. Task Manager also adds contextual actions to the Volixta Support admin interface for the authorized administrator.

Does creating a task change the original support ticket?

No. The task is linked to the original ticket, but the ticket remains in Volixta Support. Task completion and ticket status are not automatically synchronized.

Can I create multiple tasks from the same support ticket?

The integration checks whether a ticket already has a linked task. If one exists, it opens the existing task instead of creating another through the ticket conversion action.

How do I install other Volixta plugins?

Open Volixta Ecosystem from the Task Manager navigation. For supported WordPress.org plugins, use the Install plugin action if it is available. You can then activate the installed plugin.

The available actions depend on your WordPress permissions and whether the plugin is already installed.

Are other Volixta plugins required?

No. All plugins listed on the Volixta Ecosystem page are optional.

Is Volixta Task Manager Lite suitable for personal task management?

Yes. It is designed for a single WordPress administrator to manage personal projects, to-do lists and deadlines directly in WordPress.

Can several users work on the same projects?

No. The Lite edition has one workspace owner. It does not provide shared team boards, member assignments or multi-user project collaboration.

Can I customize my Kanban board?

Yes. Start with To Do, In Progress and Done. You can rename stages, add more stages and move tasks between them.

How are tasks displayed in the calendar?

Tasks with due dates appear in the calendar. Their project colors help distinguish work from different projects, and the calendar includes a project color legend.

Can I see today’s and tomorrow’s tasks on the main WordPress Dashboard?

Yes. The optional dashboard widget shows unfinished tasks grouped by deadline: overdue, today, tomorrow, within seven days, later or without a due date. You can turn it on or off in Task Manager Settings. Only the workspace owner can see it.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4 – 2026-10-26

  • Improved: Unified the interface layout across Standard, Immersive and Focus themes.
  • Improved: Standard theme now uses the same sidebar navigation, header and content structure as the other themes, with a light color palette.
  • Improved: Responsive navigation and styling for smaller screens.
  • Fixed: Inconsistent interface layouts and styling between appearance modes.

1.0.3 – 2026-10-26

  • Improved: Updated the readme.txt with clearer plugin descriptions and Volixta Support integration details.

1.0.2 – 2026-10-26

  • Fixed: Removed a duplicate logo from the setup wizard welcome screen.
  • Improved: Cleaned up unused CSS.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Removed embedded CSS from reminder emails and used email-compatible inline attributes for a mobile-friendly layout.
  • Improved: Ensured WordPress administration assets use properly scoped script and style enqueue hooks.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with projects, customizable Kanban boards, task lists, calendar, reports, private attachments, reminders, and optional Volixta Support integration.
